name: Dedicated Server
description:
⚔️ Welcome to Stacia ⚔️

Stacia is a progressive dark-fantasy MMORPG built entirely for Minecraft Bedrock! Step into an open world packed with danger, secrets, and endless progression. Forge your path, conquer the darkness, and become a legend.

🌟 Key Features:

• Custom RPG Progression: Level up your skills, unlock active abilities, and customize your build.

• Dungeons & Boss Raids: Party up with friends to conquer dangerous instances and collect legendary loot.

• Epic Gear & Artifacts: Discover rare custom weapons and armor sets with unique magical attributes.

• Player-Driven Economy: Trade rare materials, set up shops, and control the market.
